scenarios.name: creature-entry-trigger-fires-an-additional-time
scenarios.why: If an artifact or creature entering causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time: Savannah Lions entering causes Welcoming Vampire's draw trigger twice, drawing two cards.

scenarios.name: without-it-the-trigger-fires-once
scenarios.why: Control: with no Panharmonicon in play the same entering creature draws only one card.
